overview.brief: Kithicor Forest is a wooded travel corridor that changes character completely after sunset. By day it supports low-level wildlife, bixies, spiders and Shralok orcs; at night the forest becomes a haunted gauntlet as powerful undead patrol among the trees, making the same route dramatically more dangerous. Daytime hunting is recommended around levels 5–10. At night, high-level undead replace much of the ordinary population, making the zone appropriate for levels 30+ and dangerous for young travelers.
